_about: Settings for the weekly autopilot. The GitHub job and the Autopilot tab both read this file, so what the tab previews is what runs. Edit on GitHub and commit; the next hourly run uses the new values. Hard limits are enforced in code: windowMaxH can never exceed 12, hits are never taken, one chip per gameweek, and Wildcard / Free Hit are never played by the autopilot.
_minGainPerTransfer: Expected points (over the next 5 gameweeks) each transfer must add, or the free transfer is saved. 0.1 to 5.
_bankToleranceXp: How many expected points the money rule may give up to leave more in the bank. 0 = always the top-scoring option. 0 to 10.
_windowMaxH: Act only within this many hours before the deadline. 2 to 12.
_windowMinH: Stop this many hours before the deadline, so it never races the lock. 0.5 to 3.
_alertLeadH: A heads-up alert (plan, captain, chips, any Wildcard/Free Hit suggestion) goes out this many hours before the deadline, so you have time to play a suggested chip. 12 to 72, always before the window.
_oddsWeight: Captain: how much bookmaker odds (via ODDS_API_KEY) replace our model's expected goals and clean-sheet chances. 0 = model only, 1 = market only.
_fplEpWeight: Captain: share of the score taken from FPL's own projection (ep_next). 0 to 0.6.
_formWeight: Captain: share taken from recent form (points per match, last 30 days). 0 to 0.4.
_captainDifferential: Captain style. -1 = safe (template, steady), 0 = neutral, +1 = differential (low ownership, upside).
_autoTripleCaptain: true = the autopilot plays Triple Captain itself when the week is right. false = it only suggests it.
_autoBenchBoost: true = the autopilot plays Bench Boost itself when the week is right. false = it only suggests it.
_tcMinXp: Triple Captain only when the best starter is projected at least this many points (a double gameweek usually is). 4 to 20.
_bbMinXp: Bench Boost only when the four on the bench are projected at least this many points together. 3 to 25.
_chipWaitMarginPct: Hold a chip for a later gameweek only if that week is projected this much better (%). In the last gameweek before a chip expires it's played anyway. 0 to 50.
_fhMinGain: Suggest a Free Hit when the best one-week squad beats yours by this many points. 4 to 40.
_wcMinGain: Suggest a Wildcard when it beats your best free-transfer plan by this many points over 5 gameweeks. 5 to 80.
